# clavis trust ls

<p class="cli-lead">List servers trusted on this computer</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis trust ls
```

</div>

List the servers whose self-signed certificates this computer trusts, with the fingerprint, the certificate's expiry and when it was trusted.

## Examples

```sh
clavis trust ls
clavis trust ls --json
```
